check_box.label: Sky test on (this screen only)
check_box.name: GMDXSkyTest
check_box.tool_tip: A test sky on your screen only: nobody else sees it and nothing is sent. Off = back to the region's sky. Touching any control below turns it on.

combo_box.name: GMDXSkyTestBase
combo_box.tool_tip: The sky the test starts from: its colours, ambient and glow (everything the controls below do not set). 'Day cycle' blends Second Life's Midday, Sunset and Midnight by the sun's height. 'The sky in use' is the region's sky, or a personal sky you pick while testing (World > Environment > Midnight...).

button.label: Full moon high
button.name: preset_1
button.tool_tip: Sun 60 below, a full moon 60 up opposite it.

button.label: Full moon low
button.name: preset_2
button.tool_tip: Sun 12 below, a full moon 12 up opposite it.

button.label: Quarter moon
button.name: preset_3
button.tool_tip: Sun 30 below, a quarter moon 40 up.

button.label: Crescent
button.name: preset_4
button.tool_tip: Sun 20 below, a thin crescent 15 up near where it set.

button.label: Moonless
button.name: preset_5
button.tool_tip: No moon (below the horizon), clear sky: stars only.

button.label: Dusk (sun -3)
button.name: preset_6
button.tool_tip: Sun 3 degrees below the horizon, a gibbous moon 25 up.

button.label: Deep twilight (-8)
button.name: preset_7
button.tool_tip: Sun 8 degrees below, a gibbous moon 25 up.

button.label: Cloud over moon
button.name: preset_9
button.tool_tip: A high full moon behind nearly full cloud cover (slide Cloud shift to move a gap over it).

slider.label: Elevation
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestSunElevation
slider.tool_tip: The sun's height in degrees: below 0 it has set (dusk ends around -8 to -10).

slider.label: Azimuth
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestSunAzimuth
slider.tool_tip: The sun's azimuth in degrees (as in Personal Lighting).

check_box.label: Place by phase
check_box.name: GMDXSkyTestMoonByPhase
check_box.tool_tip: The moon's azimuth follows from the phase: the angle to the sun that gives it, at the moon's height. Off = set the azimuth yourself.

slider.label: Phase
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestMoonPhase
slider.tool_tip: Phase angle: 0 full, 45 gibbous, 90 quarter, 135 crescent, 180 new. If the two heights cannot give this phase, the nearest phase they can.

slider.label: Elevation
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestMoonElevation
slider.tool_tip: The moon's height in degrees: below 0 it has set (a moonless night).

slider.label: Azimuth
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestMoonAzimuth
slider.tool_tip: The moon's azimuth in degrees. Set from the phase while Place by phase is on.

slider.label: Coverage
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestCloudCoverage
slider.tool_tip: How much of the sky is cloud: near 1 the moon is behind cloud wherever it is.

slider.label: Shift X
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestCloudShiftX
slider.tool_tip: Slides the cloud field east-west (1 = a whole tile): with the clouds frozen, put a cloud or a gap in front of the moon.

slider.label: Shift Y
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestCloudShiftY
slider.tool_tip: Slides the cloud field north-south (1 = a whole tile).

check_box.label: Freeze clouds
check_box.name: GMDXSkyTestFreezeClouds
check_box.tool_tip: The clouds stand still, so they stay where Shift put them. Off = they drift as the start sky's do.

slider.label: Haze
slider.name: GMDXSkyTestHazeDensity
slider.tool_tip: Haze density: more = a thicker, brighter horizon and dimmer distance.

button.label: Back to region sky
button.name: off
button.tool_tip: Ends the test: drops the personal sky (as World > Environment > Use Shared Environment).
